written_before: class_calibration.py read any panel model outside the development set
disclosure: anomalies.py had already read PSBD-TM alone on vit_cifar10_tact_0_05, outside the development set, with an unshrunk per-predicted-class threshold, before this rule was fixed.
rule: Each probe's fractional PSU is calibrated against the clean validation images with the same unperturbed predicted class, shrunk toward the whole validation split with strength m images. Form class_percentile mixes the class CDF and the global CDF with weights n_c and m. Form class_z uses the shrunk class mean and variance. PSBD-TM alone uses its calibrated score, the final method takes the minimum or the average of the 2 calibrated scores. Every score is thresholded at a quantile of its own clean-validation values.
selection: m maximizing PSBD-TM alone's mean TPR over 1%, 5% and 10% FPR on the development set, from the grid 5, 20, 50 and 200, ties to the larger m. Both forms chose 5, the edge of the grid.
confirmation_set: rest: the 45 successful ViT panel models outside the development set, read once

predictions.text: class_z raises PSBD-TM alone's mean TPR at each of 1%, 5% and 10% FPR over the global calibration, with the paired 95% interval excluding 0
class_z raises the final method's mean TPR at each of 1%, 5% and 10% FPR under both the min and the average rule, with the paired 95% interval excluding 0
under class_z no attack's mean TPR at 1% FPR falls by more than 0.02 for PSBD-TM alone, which is the test that the rule is more than a TaCT fix
under class_z the mean realized FPR stays within 0.005 of each nominal FPR for PSBD-TM alone

expected: The development gains come from CIFAR-10 and GTSRB, where a predicted class holds 46 to 200 validation images. CIFAR-100 and Tiny ImageNet hold about 20 and 10, so the shrunk class calibration sits closer to the global one there and the gain should be smaller.
not_decided_here: Whether class_percentile or class_z is preferred. The development set favors class_z for PSBD-TM alone and the average rule, and class_percentile hurts the average rule there.
